name: N. Otto-Trąmpczyński
notes: The unnamed father of Jan the elder and Wojciech. No source names him; the decree of 1775 makes Wojciech the "stryj" (father's brother) and guardian of Jan's sons, so Jan and Wojciech were brothers. Whether he was one of the brothers Wojciech, Mikołaj and Stanisław of the division of 1522 is not known.
